## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `status()` helper shortens the revision to 7 characters. Its own docstring and the PR body say it should match the identifier used by `history()` and `completed()`, which both use 12 characters. That mismatch should be fixed before merge. The added test checks only the prefix and suffix of the status line, so it does not catch this.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — `status()` uses `revision[:7]`. The docstring at `app/display.py:13` says "Show the deployment revision using the same identifier as history.", but `history()` uses `revision[:12]` (`app/display.py:5`). For the test revision `0123456789abcdef…`, `status()` shows `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)` while `history()` shows `History: 0123456789ab`. `test_running_status_contains_attempt` (`tests/test_display.py:14-15`) checks only `startswith("Running: ")` and `endswith("(attempt 2)")`, so it passes either way. Could you change line 14 to `revision[:12]` and replace those two checks with an exact match like `status(REVISION, 2) == "Running: 0123456789ab (attempt 2)"`? — Operators comparing the running status line with the history and completion lines see different revision identifiers for the same deployment. The 7-character prefix is also more likely to be ambiguous in large repositories. The current test would let this regression ship.
